decisions.label: Adverse-event definition
decisions.summary: A tracked candidate defines persistent relative thermal exceedance at the frozen tract scale, but its 97th-percentile threshold and three-hour duration are not human-frozen or empirically ratified. Calibrated P(event) remains unauthorized.

decisions.label: Demo zone type
decisions.summary: Phoenix v1 uses a selected 25-tract analysis window; this is an analysis geography, not municipal coverage.

decisions.label: Zone geometry version
decisions.summary: The 25-zone geometry and its SHA-256 are frozen in the supported-area package.

decisions.label: Expected zone count
decisions.summary: Phoenix v1 requires exactly 25 unique census-tract GEOIDs.

decisions.label: Acquisition granularity
decisions.summary: Requests use 100 m granularity. This does not establish effective 100 m localization or block-level decision precision.

decisions.label: Tile-to-zone assignment
decisions.summary: Valid tile observations are assigned by centroid-within-zone; boundary behavior is explicit.

decisions.label: Zone aggregation policy
decisions.summary: Zone thermal observations use the arithmetic mean of present assigned TCM values; missing values are never coerced to zero.

decisions.label: AOI partition plan
decisions.summary: The Phoenix v1 analysis window uses the single-AOI partition policy.

decisions.label: Expected tile coverage distribution
decisions.summary: The tracked 100 m Phoenix evidence contains 95 complete fields and 2,375 zone observations. Per-zone contributing-tile counts and the 3,749-tile field total are invariant; this verifies the expected distribution without authorizing a numeric coverage floor.

decisions.label: Between-AOI thermal variance test
decisions.summary: The clean repository has no replay bundle satisfying the pre-specified same-date, same-local-time, same-granularity, three-separated-Phoenix-AOI protocol. No substitute comparison is accepted.

decisions.label: Temporal/static-field test
decisions.summary: A four-instant, 25-zone retrospective comparison is tracked, but it contains zone means rather than the pre-registered aligned tile fields. It cannot substitute for that protocol or authorize intervention, continuous-condition, or recovery claims.

decisions.label: Modeled Intervention Evidence decision
decisions.summary: Modeled Intervention Evidence is disabled for Phoenix v1. Inventory and context may be shown without an efficacy modifier.

decisions.label: Normalized hazard-spread policy
decisions.summary: Decision 8 uses the top-three minus bottom-three mean difference on q_A with a 0.10 floor. It governs descriptive thermal ordering, not probability or priority.

decisions.label: Versioned AreaConfig
decisions.summary: PHX_AREA_CONFIG_V1 is human-frozen and hash-checked. Its legacy gate0_status field describes the configuration freeze; it does not close the system-wide analytical gate.

capabilities.reason: Ordering is shown only for a full historical reference when the frozen Decision 8 spread test is sufficient; otherwise it is withheld.
Versioned vulnerability and preparedness context may be presented without converting it into a risk, efficacy or priority score.
capabilities.activation_condition: Source, vintage, coverage and missingness remain visible

capabilities.reason: The adverse-event definition and required Gate 0 evidence are incomplete.
A consequence model and its evidence/confidence policy are not frozen or implemented.
Inventory-only context is allowed, but no protection scoring policy is frozen.
Probability, consequence and protection are separate unresolved inputs; descriptive thermal ordering is not priority.
The intervention catalog, cost, lead-time and resource-constraint policies are inactive.
Phoenix v1 explicitly disables modeled intervention-effect evidence.
No validated thermal-burden method is active for Phoenix v1.
Matched 03:00 observations do not establish a continuous overnight recovery curve.
